title: The spamVerify debug flow is the committed regression gate for split-view changes
trigger: Any change to subtitleSplitView.ts / findPlayerContainer.ts / split-view layout — the slot-keeper regressions (body-top wrapper, collapsed height, orphaned sheet panel) only appear under rotate+rapid-t races that unit tests cannot reach
principle: Race-window layout regressions need a deterministic browser gate, not manual probing. A named flow with hard asserts (assertSplit throws on body-top y<=1, collapsed height, duplicate/orphan panels) turns 'did it regress?' into a pass/fail run.

cases.context: After fixing split-view slot placement, repeated `t` toggles regressed again on reopen because m.youtube collapses .player-placeholder once the shell is staged — only visible under rapid-toggle timing.
cases.bad: Manual probe rectangles after each fix; the verdict lives in chat and is re-derived every session.
cases.good: probe.mjs --match youtube --ext --reload && run.mjs youtube spamVerify — 3 rotate+spam rounds, hard asserts, fails loudly.

applyFor: any timing/race regression that unit tests cannot reach
flows that need pass/fail instead of log-reading
extension features verified only in a live host DOM
